title: Program Manager - IFS Loops
description:
**Company Description**  

IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.


At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**  

IFS Loops is revolutionizing how leaders and teams work with our agentic platform, driving  

unprecedented efficiency and scale. We’re establishing a new Program Management team and  

are looking for a Program Manager to join us in India, working with EST and UK time zones. This  

role is crucial for managing and delivering complex, high\-impact projects for our largest  

enterprise customers. You will work closely with clients, internal teams, and senior leadership to  

ensure successful project execution and long\-term business value.

**Key Responsibility**


As a Program Manager, you will be a key member of a newly formed team, responsible for  

delivering our most high\-profile customer engagements. This means you’ll be:

  

* Program Management: Leading and managing multiple enterprise\-level projects from initiation through delivery, optimization, and tuning.
* You’ll ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget, adhering to our Services Methodology approach.
* Customer Engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior leaders and project managers.
* You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for project\-related activities and help educate clients on the nuances of AI and AI assistants.
* **Workshop Ownership and Execution**: Taking ownership of developing workshops to support the creation of user stories and technical requirements for our customers’ AI assistants.
* **Operations**: Managing dependencies and resources, initiating change orders, and documenting all key decisions and meeting outcomes. You’ll also support the sales process as needed to instill customer confidence.
* **Team Leadership**: Coordinating services team members—including solution architects, implementation specialists, and integration engineers—to ensure cohesive project execution. You’ll also collaborate with product, customer success, and sales teams.
* **Risk Management**: Identifying potential project risks and proactively developing mitigation strategies. You’ll serve as the primary escalation point for issues that could jeopardize customer satisfaction or project completion.
* **Steering Committee Ownership**: Providing regular project updates to key senior stakeholders at both TheLoops and the customer’s organization
* **Performance Monitoring**: Tracking project performance in real time, analyzing key metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams. metrics, and preparing detailed status reports and dashboards for clients and internal teams.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Implementing best practices and lessons learned to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of project delivery and advancing operational prowess through collaboration with Services leadership.
* **Customer Success**: Working closely with Sales and Customer Success to ensure a seamless handover and continued client satisfaction post\-implementation, as well as executing follow\-on projects to grow customer value

  

**Qualifications**  

* You have 7\+ years of experience in program or project management, with a focus on enterprise clients within the technology or SaaS industry.
* You have a strong understanding of AI technologies, particularly in deploying conversational AI and automation solutions for large enterprises.
* You can communicate the nuances of AI to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You have a deep understanding of consumer customer service best practices and strategies.
* You are technically adept and comfortable with APIs, data migration, and configuring complex software integrations.
* You’re passionate about AI and possess a working understanding of concepts like LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering, and vector databases.
* You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field; a PMP or similar certification is highly desirable.
* You have proven experience building project delivery methodologies and processes.
* You’re a natural leader with excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* You’re willing to travel up to 20% of the time

**What Success Looks Like in 3–6 Months**

  

Within your first 3\-6 months, you will have successfully demonstrated your impact by:

* **Becoming an Expert**: You’ll be proficient with TheLoops’s platform and will have a deep understanding of the common challenges our customers face.
* **Leading Implementations**: You will have autonomously managed and completed at least one high\-stakes customer implementation from start to finish. This includes leading discovery, architecting the solution, configuring the platform, and successfully migrating data.
* **Driving Customer Value**: You will have received positive feedback from customers, validating that you’ve not only met their technical requirements but have also empowered their teams and improved their operational efficiency.
* **Strengthening Team Collaboration**: You will have established strong working relationships with the sales, engineering, and product teams, providing valuable feedback from the field to help improve our product and processes.


Why Join Us

* Work on cutting\-edge AI solutions that have real business impact
* Be part of a fast\-growing team shaping how enterprises deploy AI at scale
* High ownership, high visibility, and a chance to lead transformational projects
* Competitive compensation, flexible work, and the support of a global enterprise (IFS)

  

**Additional Information** *We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Project Manager - Facilities
description:
**Job Summary:**


Manages, develops, and implements project(s) of varying complexity and size in assigned functional area. Partners with business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion.


**Key Responsibilities:**


Leads multiple projects from inception to completion; facilitates project planning sessions with internal stakeholders to determine the scope and objectives of each project; works with business stakeholders to establish project performance goals; designs project plan, develops timeline, identifies project milestones, and tracks performance against performance goals and timeline. Identifies, tracks, and works with others to resolve project issues. Monitors and communicates project status to project team. Plans and monitors project budget, conducts research and analysis; provides input into the design and development of project plans and timelines. Manages project risk; uses quality tools to identify areas of risk; works with others on the team and outside the team to identify alternatives or solutions. Documents and shares team learning's with other teams; draws on other project team experiences to enhance the success of the project. Maintains project notes, databases, and other records; monitors measures and communicates with Project Sponsor and other stakeholders on status of specific projects and assignments. Identifies and assigns appropriate resources to accomplish various project tasks; guides and coaches team members through various stages of the project; provides developmental feedback to team members.


**Competencies:**


Financial acumen \- Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.


Business insight \- Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.


Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.


Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.


Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.


Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.


Plans and aligns \- Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.


Project Issue and Risk Management \- Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.


Project Resource Management \- Develops resource (expense and headcount) plans using recommended project management tools and processes to manage resources effectively.


Project Schedule Management \- Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.


Project Scope Management \- Manages a list of project deliverables (scope) using the recommended project management tools and processes to ensure that the project includes all the work required and only the work required to complete the project successfully.


Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**


College, university, or equivalent degree required (Engineering background preferred)


**Experience:**


5 to 7 years of relevant experience required.
* Manage day\-to\-day facilities operations and coordinate with internal stakeholders and service partners.
* Manage and coordinate **Integrated Facility Management (IFM)** activities and vendor operations.
* Lead and manage IFM vendor staff to ensure effective delivery of services.
* Oversee **housekeeping, transportation, cafeteria and other facility services** .
* Coordinate and manage **facility\-related projects** from planning through execution.
* Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of **HVAC systems** and other facility infrastructure.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders and vendors for facility requirements, issues and resolutions.
* Support **AOP, CAPEX and OPEX** planning and tracking.
* Manage facility budgets and monitor expenses to ensure effective utilization of resources.
* Prepare and maintain reports, presentations and dashboards related to facilities operations and projects.
* Use **MS Excel and PowerPoint** for data analysis, reporting, presentations and tracking of facility activities.

**Job** Facilities


**Organization** Cummins Inc.


**Role Category** On\-site with Flexibility


**Job Type** Exempt \- Experienced


**ReqID** 2435376


**Relocation Package** Yes


**100% On\-Site** No

title: Digital Project Manager
description:
Overview:

We are looking for an experienced **Digital Delivery Manager** to own and drive the end\-to\-end delivery of a portfolio of digital technology projects. The ideal candidate will bring strong delivery leadership, technology understanding, stakeholder management, and business acumen, with the ability to manage complex multi\-service engagements across **Application Development, Data, AI, DevOps, Cybersecurity, and Cloud**.  

The role requires someone who can operate effectively at both the **strategic and execution levels**—ensuring predictable delivery, managing risks and dependencies, driving customer satisfaction, identifying opportunities for growth, and enabling AI\-led transformation across the software development lifecycle.
Responsibilities:
* **Portfolio \& Delivery Management**
* Own the **end\-to\-end delivery of a portfolio of projects**, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, quality, budget, and customer expectations.
* Establish delivery governance, operating cadence, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms across projects.
* Manage cross\-functional teams and multiple delivery streams, including distributed and offshore/onshore teams.
* Proactively identify and manage delivery risks, dependencies, issues, and escalations.
* Ensure effective resource planning, capacity management, utilization, and talent alignment across the portfolio.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, productivity, quality, and engineering practices.
* **Agile \& AI\-Enabled Delivery**
* Strong understanding and hands\-on experience with **Agile delivery methodologies**, including Scrum, Kanban, SAFe or similar frameworks.
* Experience in **POD\-based delivery models**, with the ability to structure and manage cross\-functional engineering PODs.
* Strong understanding of **AI\-enabled SDLC** and modern software engineering practices.
* Identify opportunities to leverage **GenAI, AI\-assisted development, automation, and intelligent engineering tools** to improve productivity, quality, and delivery velocity.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, DevSecOps, cloud\-native development, and engineering automation.
* **Technology \& Change Management**
* Possess sufficient technical depth to review proposed **Change Requests**, assess technical and delivery impact, and challenge estimates where required.
* Evaluate impact of changes on architecture, scope, effort, timelines, dependencies, resources, cost, and quality.
* Work closely with architects, engineering leads, product owners, and business stakeholders to ensure technically sound delivery decisions.
* Understand modern technology landscapes spanning **Application Development, Data Engineering, AI/ML, Cloud, DevOps, and Cybersecurity**.
* **Stakeholder \& Customer Management**
* Act as a senior point of contact for customers and business stakeholders across the delivery portfolio.
* Build strong relationships with CXO, business, technology, product, and program\-level stakeholders.
* Provide clear and concise communication on delivery status, risks, financials, dependencies, and strategic initiatives.
* Manage escalations effectively and drive issues to resolution.
* Build customer confidence through predictable delivery, transparency, and proactive communication.
* **Business Growth \& Account Expansion**
* Identify and drive **business growth opportunities** within existing engagements and accounts.
* Understand customer business priorities and translate them into technology and transformation opportunities.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, and technology teams to identify opportunities for **new services, projects, and account expansion**.
* Experience managing or contributing to multi\-service engagements involving **Application Development, Data, AI, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity**, etc.
* Support proposals, solution discussions, RFP/RFI responses, estimates, and customer presentations when required.
* **Multi\-Domain \& Multi\-Service Experience**
* Experience working across multiple technology services and complex enterprise environments.
* Exposure to multiple business domains is highly desirable, particularly **BFSI and Enterprise** environments.
* Ability to quickly understand different business contexts, operating models, and technology landscapes.


Essential skills:
* Proven experience managing **multiple projects/programs as a portfolio** with end\-to\-end delivery ownership.
* Strong experience in **Agile delivery and POD\-based delivery models**.
* Understanding and practical experience with **AI\-enabled SDLC / AI\-assisted software engineering**.
* Strong technical background with the ability to engage with architects and engineering teams and review technical proposals and Change Requests.
* Experience across multiple technology services such as:
* + Application Development \& Modernization
	+ Data Engineering \& Analytics
	+ AI/ML \& GenAI
	+ Cloud
	+ DevOps / DevSecOps
	+ Cybersecurity
* Excellent **communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management** skills.
* Demonstrated experience in **customer management and account growth**.
* Strong understanding of delivery governance, financial management, resource management, quality, and risk management.
* Experience working with distributed/global teams.


Desired skills:
* Experience across multiple domains such as **BFSI, Enterprise, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, or Telecom**.
* Experience managing large or complex digital transformation programs.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
* Experience driving **GenAI adoption within engineering and delivery organizations**.
* Experience in pre\-sales, solutioning, estimation, and account expansion.
* Relevant certifications such as **PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, Scrum Master/Product Owner, or ITIL** are an advantage.


Experience:
* **15–17 years of overall experience** in software/technology delivery.

title: Techno-Functional Project Manager / Business Senior Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Business Senior Analyst is an intermediate\-level position responsible for liaising between business users and technologists to exchange information in a concise, logical and understandable way in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of business performance and other measures to gain insight and drive business planning.


**Job Responsibilities:**

The candidate will execute a wide range of Enterprise Application enhancements / Implementations / upgrade and support activities within Technology Organization / Supply Chain functions, both quantitative and qualitative in nature to support program management.


**Project Manager Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and roadmaps.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including business, technology, operations, and vendors.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, quality standards, and budget.
* Facilitate decision\-making by providing project insights, metrics, and recommendations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify and mitigate project risks and implement corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance, change management, and delivery frameworks.
* Will be responsible for working with Operations/Finance and business stakeholders.
* Knowledge on AI tools, application of AI enablement for P2P processes

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Remove impediments and blockers impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and self\-organization within the team.
* Monitor sprint progress and ensure delivery commitments are achieved.
* Use Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown Charts, and Sprint Health indicators to improve team performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote Agile maturity across teams

Experience


* 8\-11 years’ experience in project management
* Experienced Project manager \& business analyst in relevant field Oracle ERP Financial modules.
* PMP/SAFE certified Project managers
* Attention to detail to ensure precision of data and overall quality of outputs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.).
* Ability to embrace and master new technologies and changing processes.
* Can work independently with minimal supervision is required, as well as ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented atmosphere.
* Excellent follow\-up skills with attention to detail and ability to multi\-task, strong leadership skills, strong team\-orientation and interpersonal skills, flexibility and strong analytical skills.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills.
* Ability to establish rapport and build effective relationships across functions, across regions, and across all levels of management.
* Motivated self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and possesses the ability to successfully manage multiple requests in a deadline\-driven environment

Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
